Pump.fun’s token factory has a 69% launch-day death rate: CoinGecko

The study reviewed 18.67m tokens created on the Solana-based meme coin launchpad from Jan. 14, 2024, to June 18, 2026.

CoinGecko said 12.8m tokens, or 68.67% of the total, recorded their final Pump.fun bonding-curve trade on launch day.

The report said just 850,180 tokens, or 4.55%, lasted more than 90 days.
